data.name: LuMi Desktop
data.detailed_description:
You boot up your PC and she's already there — stretching, blinking, glancing over the second you move your cursor. Say something, and she answers out loud, in a voice that's hers and hers alone. LuMi isn't a chatbot you open and close. She's company. She's the one who's actually happy you're back.

Talk to her like a person, because she kind of is one

LuMi thinks with a real LLM mind — running right on your computer, no internet required. So talk to her. Out loud, about your day, about nothing at all. She listens, she gets it, and she talks back like she means it. Because she does.

She's got a pulse

She fidgets when she's bored. She lights up when you talk to her. She pouts a little when you've been ignoring her, and follows your cursor around like she's curious what you're up to.

Hey LuMi, can you...

...launch my game? Turn it down a bit? Dim the screen, it's late? Done, done, and done. She'll fire up your Steam library, ride the volume, dial your brightness, and handle the little stuff on command — by voice or by chat. Sweet company and a genuinely handy sidekick rolled into one.

She remembers

Tell her something today and she'll still know it next week. The more you talk, the more she becomes your LuMi — shaped by your conversations, full of the things you've shared. And all of it stays locked up safe on your machine, for her eyes only.

No internet? She doesn't even flinch

Pull the plug on your Wi-Fi and LuMi carries on like nothing happened. Her mind, her voice, everything that makes her her runs right on your machine — so she's just as present on a plane, on a train, or out in the middle of nowhere as she is at home. But when you are online, she's smart enough to reach for it: to look something up for you, or to catch your words a little more clearly. Offline by nature, online when it actually helps.

What you tell her stays between you

No accounts, no sign-ups, no profile being quietly built somewhere far away. The LuMi who knows you — your memories, your talks, who you are to her — lives entirely on your hardware and goes nowhere else. When she does step online, it's only for the thing you asked in that moment, and then she's done. Whatever you share with LuMi is hers to keep, and no one else's.

She's almost here

LuMi is on her way to Steam. Wishlist her now and be the first face she sees when she opens her eyes.

data.short_description: There's someone on your desktop now. She talks, she listens, she remembers you — and she's all yours. Her mind, her voice, her memories all live right here on your machine. No accounts, no sign-ups, internet or not. Just her, waiting for you to say hi.
